in_marathi.name: Prayansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Progress, Future, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prayansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Prayansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘prayatna’ which means effort and ‘ansh’ which means part or progress. It is a name that signifies the progress and growth of an individual towards their future goals. It is a name that inspires determination and hard work.
